data.title: Solana, Ethereum, XRP Outperform Bitcoin In $69K Rally – $1.6B In Crypto Bets Get Wiped Out
data.description: Ethereum (ETH), Ripple (XRP) and Solana (SOL) outperformed Bitcoin (BTC) on Wednesday morning as the apex cryptocurrency shot past $69,000 for the first time since June.The sudden rally that came after the U.S. Treasury announced it would double its bond buyback operations wiped out over $1 billion…
